input: Deep clean the fridge and restock shelves

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether the clean covers only the interior, or also drawers, door seals, exterior, coils, and drip trays changes the steps and time required significantly.
Whether this is for a household, a shared office, or a family with specific dietary needs affects what gets restocked and how items are organised.
The current state of the fridge (mildly untidy vs. heavily soiled with spills or expired food) determines how intensive the cleaning effort needs to be.
A budget for restocking shapes what gets bought and whether a grocery run is part of the task or just reorganising existing items.
Knowing the target date and time — especially if food needs to be kept cold — determines whether items must be temporarily stored in a cooler and how long the fridge can be off.
An organisational system preference (by food type, meal-prep containers, labels, FIFO rotation) determines how shelves are arranged after restocking.
Understanding what 'done well' looks like — odour-free, photo-ready, fully stocked for the week — sets the quality bar and confirms when the task is truly complete.

gold.taskTitle: Deep clean and restock the fridge
gold.taskDescription: Thoroughly clean the interior and exterior of the fridge, then refill and organise its shelves with fresh items.

questions.title: Which parts of the fridge are included in the clean?
questions.description: Does the clean cover only the interior shelves and drawers, or also door seals, the exterior surfaces, the drip tray, and the coils at the back?

questions.title: Who is this fridge stocked for?
questions.description: Is this a personal fridge, a family household, a shared office, or a rental property? Dietary needs or preferences of the users will affect what gets restocked.

questions.title: How dirty or cluttered is the fridge right now?
questions.description: Is it lightly untidy, or are there old spills, strong odours, expired items, or sticky residue that need heavy-duty treatment?

questions.title: Is there a budget set aside for restocking groceries?
questions.description: Should the plan include a grocery shop with a specific spend limit, or is this purely about reorganising and cleaning with items already on hand?

questions.title: When do you want this fully done by?
questions.description: Knowing the deadline helps determine whether a cooler is needed for displaced food and how to sequence the cleaning and shopping steps.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred system for organising the shelves?
questions.description: Should items be grouped by category, arranged for meal-prep, stored with labels, or rotated by expiry date (FIFO)?

questions.title: What would a perfectly completed fridge look like to you?
questions.description: For example: odour-free and sanitised, visually tidy and photo-ready, or fully stocked with a specific week's worth of meals — what is the quality bar?
